headline: Oxfam: Gaza environment severely contaminated
pages: Oxfam and the Conflict and Environment Observatory said Monday that Gaza has become a toxic wasteland. Their report, based on satellite imagery and open-source data, says more than 99% of the territory shows indicators of environmental contamination. It lists heavy metals, explosive residues, asbestos from destroyed buildings, dioxins and biological contaminants as threats that could last decades. Oxfam International executive director Amitabh Behar accused Israel of environmental war crimes. The Israeli embassy in the UK said the report falls short of professional standards. Israel says its campaign is self-defence against Hamas.
The UN Environment Programme earlier estimated the war had generated more than 61 million tonnes of debris in Gaza. Source: BBC News.
